newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Seven killed in fiery Colombian road crash.
newsitem.headline: Seven killed in fiery Colombian road crash.

text.p: Seven people were killed on Sunday when a fuel-laden tanker truck careened out of control on a steep hill approaching a city in central Colombia and slammed into five other vehicles before bursting into flames, authorities said.

Civil defence and municipal officials in Villavicencio, capital of southeastern Meta province, said the truck ploughed into four taxis and a car, dragging three of them along with it, before it exploded in a fireball.
The truck apparently lost its brakes on the approach into Villavicencio, officials said.
The accident came a day after Villavicencio's mayor joined hundreds of people in a protest march on the capital, Bogota, to demand the completion of a new Bogota-Villavicencio highway.
A Brazilian engineering firm abandoned the two-year-old highway project earlier this month because of repeated leftist guerrilla attacks in the area, just southeast of Bogota.
